global: Rain again over the {town} road. Mud means slower carts and fatter costs, so my mood is about as damp as my boots.
Whoever keeps moving the map markers, please stop. I lost a whole morning to a route that isn't there anymore.
Lag spike just ate my caravan halfway to {village}. Two crates of spice and a very confused mule.
If the toll gate at {village} wants one more copper per cart, I'm building a bridge out of spite.
Someone tell me why a sack of barley costs more than a horse in {town} now. I'd like a word with whoever set that.
Quiet morning on the trade roads. I don't trust it. Quiet roads usually mean someone's lurking in the hedges.
A merchant, a mule and a map walk into an inn. Only two of them could read the price board.
Sold out of salt in {town} before noon. Some of you should set your alarms earlier.
Honest question: does anyone actually enjoy the long haul through the hills, or do we all just tolerate it for the profit?
Sunset over the river was lovely. Shame it cost me a day's wages in tolls to get there.
